> This is a demo website built by NorthWeb.co for the Retail / Brand industry.

## What this site is
Collection Showcase is a professionally designed demo website showcasing how a retail / brand business can look online. It was built by NorthWeb.co (yourdomain.com) as part of their client portfolio of web design services.

## Tagline
Beautiful product displays that convert browsers into buyers

## Description
Showcase your store or brand with a stunning, mobile-first product collection website.

## Industry
Retail / Brand

## Key Features
- Product Showcase: High-quality images with detailed descriptions that convert browsers into buyers.
- Smart Filters: Category and price filters help customers find exactly what they want.
- Mobile First: Looks stunning on every device — phones, tablets, and desktops.
- WhatsApp Enquiry: One-tap WhatsApp button for instant customer conversations.
- Image Gallery: Swipeable, zoomable galleries that showcase your products beautifully.
- Lightning Fast: Optimised for speed — loads in under 2 seconds even on 4G.
